intro: A heavy cask of fiery Barleybrew Scalder ale, given to brave adventurers venturing to Stormwind. It serves as both a thirst-quenching gift and an informal currency between old acquaintances.

p: Barleybrew Scalder is a renowned ale capable of warming even the chillest dwarf. Entrusted to travelers who have proven their mettle across the Rethban Gauntlet, this cask is sent directly to Furen Longbeard in Stormwind's Dwarven District. Longbeard, an artisan shieldsmith, considers dry times an intolerable condition, making this potent brew the perfect lever to call in an old favor and secure high-quality dwarven craftsmanship.
